identity.name: PGSaathi
identity.metaphor: The Indian Courtyard (Aangan) - Warm, communal, organized

typography.rules: Headings must use Manrope. Body uses Inter. Never use Inter for Headings. Use tight tracking for headings (-0.02em).

primary.name: Terracotta Saffron
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, Active States, Key Actions

secondary.name: Sage Green
secondary.usage: Success states, Financial positives, Safe status

colors.gradients: No linear gradients. Use subtle mesh or noise overlays if needed. Prefer flat, rich colors.

layout_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid (refer to MODE B in system rules). Mix of 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 widgets.
layout_strategy.marketing: Asymmetric 'Tetris' Grid (MODE A). Large imagery, overlapping text.
layout_strategy.mobile_nav: Bottom Navigation Bar (Fixed) for Tenants/Wardens. Sidebar for Owners (Desktop).
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.

cards.style: Flat with 1px border (stone-200). Hover: Lift (-2px) + Shadow-md. Rounded-xl.

buttons.primary: bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-semibold shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-900 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.outline: border-2 border-stone-200 hover:border-amber-600 hover:text-amber-600 text-stone-600 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium bg-transparent

inputs.style: bg-white border border-stone-200 focus:border-amber-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-600 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 shadow-sm

badges.style: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px (Light/Elegant). Color: stone-600 default, amber-600 active.

images.description: Diverse Indian students studying outdoors - Use for Landing Page Hero
Group of students in uniforms - Use for Tenant Portal Welcome
Cozy hostel room with numbered door - Use for Property Management Empty State
Bunk beds in dorm - Use for Bed Management Section

visual_assets.illustration_style: Use 'Notion-style' minimal black and white illustrations or 3D avatars if available. Avoid generic vector art.

motion.loading: Use a spinning 'Chakra' or simple circular loader in Amber-600.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-stone-600+ on stone-100 backgrounds. Amber-600 is safe on white.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px height for all mobile buttons.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid Warm Sand (#FDFBF7) or Clean White.
Do NOT center-align text in dashboards. Left align for readability.
Use 'Sonner' for toast notifications (Rich, descriptive toasts).
Forms: Use Labels above inputs. Use placeholder text sparsely.
Language Toggle: Must be prominent in the Navbar/Sidebar.
Mobile Responsive: All tables must turn into 'Cards' on mobile view.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Language Selection' screen as the very first interaction.
Build the 'Owner Dashboard' with a Bento Grid layout showing: Occupancy Rate, Revenue (INR), Complaints, and Recent Tenants.
Property Management: Use a hierarchical tree or card view (Property -> Floor -> Room -> Bed).
Bed Status: Use visual indicators (Green Circle = Available, Red Circle = Occupied, Grey = Maintenance).
Rent Management: Simple ledger view. Green for Paid, Red for Overdue.
Use the provided image URLs for the Landing Page and Empty States.
